name: Hamilton Southeastern Schools
districtFact: Hamilton Southeastern Schools publishes one-page calendars that distinguish the first full day for all students, staff orientation days, semester and grading-period endings, separate Fishers High School and Hamilton Southeastern High School graduation dates, and virtual learning when school is canceled.

districtFaqs.q: Does HSE list separate graduation dates for its two high schools?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The district calendar lists separate graduation dates for Fishers High School and Hamilton Southeastern High School. Each reviewed school year page shows both dates.

districtFaqs.q: What does HSE say happens when school is canceled?
districtFaqs.a: Each reviewed HSE district calendar states that virtual learning days will be used if school is canceled. Families should check current district and school messages when a cancellation occurs.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify HSE calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official HSE Schools district calendars page and current district announcements. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and does not update automatically when HSE revises a calendar.
